findings.summary: Saving a goal now requires an active Connection with the contact's linked account, which contradicts the product's model of goals on owner-held contact records: contacts without a linked account, or who haven't accepted an invitation, can no longer have any goal.
findings.evidence: preconditions: [Owned contact, Active Connection with the contact's linked account, Valid interval] / "A goal may be saved only for a contact with an active Connection."

findings.summary: The operation's description was not updated and still says the only preconditions are an owned contact and a valid interval, so it contradicts the new Connection precondition.
findings.evidence: description: Owned contact and valid interval. Increment goal version, ... vs preconditions: [Owned contact, Active Connection with the contact's linked account, Valid interval]

findings.summary: Edit goal is now gated on an accepted invitation, but the goals journey defines no alternate path or messaging for unconnected contacts, and existing goals on unconnected contacts become uneditable.
findings.evidence: action: Choose Edit goal (available once the person has accepted an invitation) / failure: [Not available until the person has accepted an invitation]
